patch.value: Adopt the pm-cli 2026.7.26 typed authoring SDK, drop the last any-typed shim, and de-binary the source file

This package was missed by the fleet-wide 2026.7.26 typed-authoring rollout and was the 14th and last package still carrying the retired any-typed defineExtension shim. Replace it with the fleet-standard locally declared typed identity helper constrained by the SDK's own ExtensionModule, bump the host to 2026.7.26, and declare the peer dependency the rest of the fleet declares. Also replaces a literal NUL byte in the source with its escape sequence.
No any remains in the source; the extension activates and every command runs against a real workspace; index.ts is plain UTF-8 text and greppable; peerDependencies matches the fleet convention.

patch.value: Shim replaced with the typed identity helper; host bumped to 2026.7.26 with the fleet-standard peer dependency declared; literal NUL replaced with its escape sequence.

Zero any in the source. 91/91 unit tests green and typecheck clean under real SDK types. Functionally verified in a throwaway workspace, not just under unit tests: pm install activated the extension with 0 activation failures and 3 registered actions; pm standup correctly refused to post with no webhook (exit 2, actionable message); --dry-run categorised 4 real items as 2 in-progress / 0 blocked / 1 up-next; after adding a real blocked_by edge it correctly re-categorised to 1 in-progress / 1 blocked and rendered the blocker id; standup export --format json emitted a valid Block Kit payload. index.ts now reports as UTF-8 text and grep finds symbols in it.
